ideas.name: Crumbstack
ideas.pitch: Catch falling ingredients and stack burgers exactly as ordered.
ideas.notes: Apple Developer account in review. Next: TestFlight.

ideas.name: Tidy Tides
ideas.pitch: Idle-arcade coast cleanup: collect washed-up trash, recycle it into goods, stock your counter, and hire animal helpers to automate it. Restore a coast, then set sail to the next one for Sea Stars and permanent perks.
ideas.notes: Play it: aidenstreck.github.io/crumbstack/prototypes/tidy-tides/ · 13 coasts (Sunny Coast to Glow Lagoon), then endless tours with twists. Sea Stars, perks, album, daily tasks, decorating, Spooky Shore event.

ideas.name: Sunsprout
ideas.pitch: Calm light puzzle: turn and place mirrors, split beams with crystals and tint them with coloured glass so every seed pot gets exactly the sunlight it needs. A daily puzzle and a garden that grows as you solve.
ideas.notes: Play it: aidenstreck.github.io/crumbstack/prototypes/sunsprout/ · 5 puzzle gardens × 250 levels (Turn, Place, Split, Color, Warp; all solver-checked), optional challenge level every 10th, leaf ratings, undo, daily puzzle that only uses modes you've learned, garden.

ideas.name: Moon Mail
ideas.pitch: One-thumb arcade: a cat mail carrier hops between tiny spinning planets delivering letters. Tap to jump, chase high scores.
ideas.notes: High-score games spread well on TikTok: people post their best runs.

ideas.name: Hatchwild
ideas.pitch: Grow an island base, hatch and merge critters into an army, pair them for rare hybrids, and take rival islands across four regions that unlock over weeks.
ideas.notes: Play it: aidenstreck.github.io/crumbstack/prototypes/hatchwild/ · Stands out by mixing base-building battles with merge (3→1) and pairing for hybrids. All original names, art and creatures (no Supercell/Big Blue Bubble/merge-game assets). Real-time build timers grow ~2.3x per level so regions take weeks to open. Add #fast to the link to run timers 60x for testing.
